monday.label: Push (Chest / Shoulders / Triceps)
monday.warmup: Treadmill incline walk 5 min + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + DB front raise 5 lbs × 10
monday.cooldown: Doorway pec stretch 60s ea side + cross-body shoulder stretch 60s ea side + overhead triceps stretch 60s ea side

Hold — 10×3 on 8/30. Keep 2 reps in reserve; 12×3 eventually unlocks 55
Hold — 10×3 on 8/30. Strict form, no swing
Hold — 12/12/10 on 8/30. Finish the third set before progressing
Hold — 12/11/12 on 8/30. Re-own 12×3 before targeting 60

tuesday.label: Pull (Back / Biceps / Rear Delts)
tuesday.warmup: Rower 5 min + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + scap pull-ups × 10
tuesday.cooldown: Child's pose with side reach 60s ea side + cross-body rear-delt stretch 60s ea side + gentle forearm stretch 45s ea side

Repeat the confirmed W36 15×3. Strict only; bank 25 for W39
Repeat the confirmed W36 target; no hip swing
Repeat the confirmed W36 target; finish 10×3 before targeting 12
Repeat the confirmed W36 target: 25 sec each side. Tall posture, no lean

wednesday.label: Legs (Quads / Hams / Glutes / Calves / Core)
wednesday.warmup: Easy treadmill 5–8 min + controlled bodyweight squats × 10 + glute bridges × 10 + progressive ramp-up sets. Pain rule: keep left groin/adductor discomfort at 0–2/10; stop or modify anything sharp, worsening, or movement-changing
wednesday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + gentle standing quad stretch 45s ea side + gentle hamstring stretch 45s ea side + calf stretch 45s ea side. No wide-stance or aggressive adductor stretching

exercises.notes: Hold the hip-protective 9/1 load. Do not return to 150 yet; use pain-free depth
Consolidate the two successful 320-lb sets from 9/1; 270 lbs was set 1. Use 270 for the first work set if the hip check is not completely quiet
Hold — 10/10/9 on 9/1. Controlled eccentric; double-overhand grip
Hold — 12/12/10 on 9/1. Re-own 10×3 before targeting 12
Hold — 10/10/9 on 9/1. Full lockout without provoking the hip
Hold — 15/15/14 on 9/1. Full range and controlled pause
Repeat 9/1's 10×3; controlled spinal flexion
Repeat 9/1's 12×3; plate held to chest, controlled extension

thursday.label: Upper Hybrid (Shoulders / Chest / Back / Arms / Core)
thursday.warmup: Rower 5 min + scap circles + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2
thursday.cooldown: Doorway pec stretch 60s ea side + child's pose with side reach 60s ea side + cross-body shoulder stretch 60s ea side

exercises.notes: Hold despite 12×3 on 9/2. Re-entry target is 10×3; bank 55 for W39
Re-own 10×3 after 11/12/11 on 9/2; then return to the 12-rep target
Repeat 9/2's 16/15/15 with strict form
Repeat 9/2's 15×3; bank 65 for W39
Repeat 9/2's 10×3
Re-own 10×3 after 12/12/11 on 9/2; then return to the 12-rep target
Re-own the new load after 9/9/7 on 9/2; no progression yet
Repeat 9/2's target; controlled anti-rotation
Repeat the 60-second milestone with level hips and controlled breathing

friday.label: Lower Hybrid (Glutes / Quads / Hams / Calves / Core)
friday.warmup: Easy bike or treadmill 5–8 min + controlled bodyweight squats × 10 + glute bridges × 10 + gentle reverse lunges only if pain-free + progressive ramp-up sets. No wide hip openers
friday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + gentle quad, hamstring, and calf stretches 45s ea side. No wide-leg, straddle, 90/90, figure-4, or other position that reproduces the inner-thigh pull

exercises.notes: Repeat 9/4's 12×3. LEFT first; pain-free depth; not a load-progression test
Repeat 9/4's 15×3. Comfortable hip-width tracks and pain-free depth
Repeat 9/4's 15×3; bank 80 for W39
Repeat 9/4's 15×3. Controlled symptom-free middle ROM; no load increase
Repeat 9/4's 13/12/12. Left first; full range
Repeat 9/4's 15/12/12. Re-own 12×3 before progressing
